Why can't they pay for it? And we won't help subsidize life saving health care for those who need it. Pretty sad.

So spend more taxpayer money to buy more icebreakers so that ultra wealthy great lakes shipping companies can be subsidized by the middle and working classes? Let the damn shipping companies pay for it, it only benefits them! There's no pleasure crafts plying the waters this time of year.

How about we get some fair return on US taxpayers paying for icebreakers & subsidizing Great Lakes shipping by extending the shipping season? Tell them it is time to fix their ballast systems so they stop spreading invasive critters all around the Great Lakes? Retrofitting costs should not matter!
